correctness.rationale: For the ordered orthogonal five-plus-five spherical vertices, all 25 simplicial facets persist under small perturbations; local four-volume equals their oriented determinant sum divided by 24. In normalized tangent charts, direct second variation gives Q=(5s²/24)[(1/2)sum(delta alpha)²+(1/2)sum(delta beta)²+sum|u|²+sum|v|²]+(25s²/24)tr(UW). Projection onto first Fourier harmonics and completion of a matrix square isolate the four mixed rotational zero modes, four positive mixed modes, 12 residual modes, and the two five-cycle angular Laplacians. Their exact eigenvalues and multiplicities exhaust all 30 degrees of freedom; the least positive is 25/192, and the only six zero modes are rigid rotations. A uniform smooth tubular expansion about the compact orbit gives the quantified local inequality, and a first angular Fourier mode shows sharpness. The supplied script, executed from its actual package path, passed exact SymPy identities and independent numerical determinant-Hessian/finite-difference checks; the proof does not rely on finite experimentation.
